title: Minimum Spanning Tree Total Weight (Kruskal)

monster.defeatQuote: Minimal total weight to span all vertices without cycles calculated!

description: Given `n` vertices (0 to n - 1) and an undirected weighted edge list `edges` where `edges[i] = [ui, vi, weighti]`, return the total weight of the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). If the graph is not connected, return -1.
starterCode:
def minSpanningTreeWeight(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minSpanningTreeWeight(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    if n <= 1: return 0
    edges.sort(key=lambda x: x[2])
    parent = list(range(n))
    def find(i):
        if parent[i] == i: return i
        parent[i] = find(parent[i])
        return parent[i]
    mst_weight = 0
    edges_count = 0
    for u, v, w in edges:
        ru, rv = find(u), find(v)
        if ru != rv:
            parent[ru] = rv
            mst_weight += w
            edges_count += 1
            if edges_count == n - 1: return mst_weight
    return -1
